574-7084-8293.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Cleveland Booker triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Repeat.
574-7084-8293.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

4770-4885-5301-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

730-1479-2841-8104.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Misty Rainforest.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
730-1479-2841-8104.description:
Fetch a land using Misty Rainforest.
When the fetched land enters, Emeria Angel and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2438-2728-4153-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2438-2728-4153-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2438-2728-4153-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 4.

280-1315-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Golgari Rot Farm from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Repeat.

215-1355-4885.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1355-4885.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3129-5184-5660-6462-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating three Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{G}.
Repeat.

728-2113-2577.description:
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, adding {B}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Gravecrawler, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

5686-7430--5.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability and Gorma trigger.
Resolve the Gorma trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Gorma.
Remove a +1/+1 and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat
5686-7430--5.notes: Each loop, Gorma will place an additional +1/+1 counter on the persist creature compared to the previous loop. This'll eventually result in both the persist creature and Gorma having infinite +1/+1 counters on them.

4771-5220-6900-7192.description:
Cast Myr Scrapling by paying its mana cost.
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1409-3671-5921.description:
Activate Wily Goblin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Wily Goblin enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Wily Goblin.
Resolve both Wily Goblin triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2921-4681-5170-6273.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Embalmed Ascendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3129-4682-5140-5184.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
3129-4682-5140-5184.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create four Treasure tokens due to Primal Vigor and Xorn.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}.
Repeat.
3129-4682-5140-5184.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

1479-2841-5671-6157.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bant Panorama.

Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.

Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the The Necrobloom from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, The Necrobloom triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

3188-3490-4050-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Social Climber triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

Funeral Room is unlocked.

38-5220-5931-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.

Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Funeral Room trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

3430-3525.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}, and Pemmin's Aura is attached to that creature.
3430-3525.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.

1580-2292-4871-6663.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.

4823-5256-6490--88.notablePrerequisites:
You have enough mana available each turn to cast the extra turn spell and enough mana each extra turn to cast Timeless Witness.
You have not cast a spell using Kotis
4823-5256-6490--88.description:
Cast the extra turn spell by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Timeless Witness, causing you to mill cards equal to Timeless Witness's power.
Cast Timeless Witness from your graveyard by paying its mana cost and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, ensuring not to exile the extra turn spell.
When Timeless Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the extra turn spell from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1270-2043-5231-5446.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating three token copies of Esika's Chariot.

Activate Thermopod six times by sacrificing six Cats, adding six {R}.
Repeat.
1270-2043-5231-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may target any other artifact(s) with Urza's ability.

248-1110-3362.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Changeling Berserker.
248-1110-3362.description:
Cast Changeling Berserker by paying {3}{R}.
When Changeling Berserker enters the battlefield, it and Terror of the Peaks trigger.
Resolve the Changeling Berserker trigger, exiling Bladewing until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing damage to Changeling Berserker equal to Changeling Berserker's power.
Changeling Berserker dies as a state-based action due to having 0 or less toughness.
When Changeling Berserker dies, it triggers, returning Bladewing from exile to the battlefield.
When Bladewing enters the battlefield, it and Terror of the Peaks trigger.
Resolve the Terror of the Peaks trigger, dealing damage equal to Bladewing's power to any target.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, returning Changeling Berserker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

765-1479-4677.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1479-4677.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it, Zendikar's Roil, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Guildless Commons from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, it and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

513-1031-1367.description:

Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Invasion of Arcavios to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle it into your library.
Repeat each turn.

Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Temporal Manipulation to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

872-959-1644-4423.notablePrerequisites:
Scaled Herbalist does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least three other Islands.

Cast Tidal Bore by returning Mystic Sanctuary from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Scaled Herbalist.

Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield untapped, triggering itself and Tatyova.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, returning Tidal Bore from your graveyard to the top of your library.
Resolve the Tatyova trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw Tidal Bore from the top of your library.
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.

654-1525-3063-3819.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least ten Gates with different names on the battlefield, in hand and/or in library.
You have a land card in hand.
654-1525-3063-3819.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Cultivator Colossus enters the battlefield, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped, then revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, putting it in your hand and the rest of the revealed cards on the bottom of your library in any order.
Repeat this process, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat step 3 until you have Maze's End and ten Gates with different names on the battlefield.
Maze's End and each of the Gates enter the battlefield, triggering Amulet of Vigor, untapping each of the Gates and Maze's End.
Activate three of the Gates by tapping them, adding {3}.
Activate Maze's End's second ability by paying {3}, tapping it and returning Maze's End to your hand, causing you to win the game.

Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pentavus, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Pentavite, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pentavus' second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing the Pentavite.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Pentavus ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 3.

Su-Chi dies, triggering itself and Sigil of New Dawn.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Sigil of New Dawn trigger, causing you to pay {1}{W} to return Su-Chi from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Su-Chi by paying {1}.
Repeat.

4821-5054.notablePrerequisites: One or more nonland permanents able to produce {3}{R}.

Pay {2}{R} to activate League Guildmage to make a copy of Dramatic Reversal.
Untap all of your nonland permanents.
Tap your nonland permanents to produce {3}{R}.

738-1778-4659-4733.description:
Sacrifice Memnite to Krark-Clan Ironworks, adding {C}{C}.
Dictate of Erebos triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Memnite to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
